basic_details.job_title: IIT Indore JRF (Mechanical Engineering) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Mechanical Engineering at the Indian Institute of Technology Indore has invited applications for one JRF post in a SERB-funded research project on a Ti6Al4V/hydroxyapatite-based functionally graded material. The appointment is for 6 months with a fellowship of 37000+HRA @20%. The essential qualification is M.Tech. in Manufacturing Engineering, M.Tech. in Metallurgy Engineering or M.S in Mechanical Engineering. Candidates apply by emailing a single PDF to [email protected] by 1 December 2026; the interview is on 3 December 2026.

how_to_apply: Prepare a detailed softcopy of your CV.
Combine it with the Essential Qualification Degree Certificates, Marks Sheets, GATE qualifying certificates and Date of Birth Proof Certificate, all in a single PDF file.
Email the single PDF file to [email protected] on or before 1 December 2026.
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview. All documents must be sent together in a single PDF file.

content_sections.heading: IIT Indore JRF at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: Development of Ti6Al4V/hydroxyapatite-based functionally graded material using direct metal laser sintering for orthopedic implant application.

content_sections.heading: About the Institute
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the Research & Development Section of the Indian Institute of Technology Indore, Khandwa Road, Simrol, Indore 453552, India. The post is in a research project funded by SERB and based in the Department of Mechanical Engineering. This is a project-based research post at a government institute.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential qualification: M.Tech. in Manufacturing Engineering or M.Tech. in Metallurgy Engineering or M.S in Mechanical Engineering. Desirable qualification: Expertise in metallurgical characterization. Age limit: 35 years. The notice prints no cut-off date for counting age and lists no age relaxation. Candidates should read the official notification for any further eligibility detail.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The fellowship is 37000+HRA @20%, so HRA at 20% is stated alongside the fellowship amount. The duration of the appointment is 6 Months. The selected candidate will be encouraged to register for the PhD program at IIT Indore as per the institute norms. If selected for the PhD program, a fellowship will be extended for PhD duration as per institute norms.

content_sections.heading: IIT Indore JRF Job Description
content_sections.text: The candidate has to perform metallurgical characterization on additively manufactured Ti6Al4V-Hydroxyapatite composite.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Indore JRF
content_sections.text: Prepare a detailed softcopy of your CV. Combine it with the Essential Qualification Degree Certificates, Marks Sheets, GATE qualifying certificates and Date of Birth Proof Certificate, all in a single PDF file. Email the single PDF file to [email protected] on or before 1 December 2026. Documents named in the notice: Detailed CV Essential Qualification Degree Certificates Marks Sheets GATE qualifying certificates Date of Birth Proof Certificate

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview, which is scheduled for 3 December 2026. The venue and reporting time are not specified in the notice. Selected candidates will be informed by email.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview. All documents must be sent together in a single PDF file.
